technique_name: Rearange the given sentences to form a complete story.
description: Sarah and her family had gathered together in the living room to celebrate her brother's birthday. Suddenly, the lights went out and the room fell silent. Full of anticipation, they waited in the darkness until the lights came back on.
example:
a. Suddenly, the lights went out and the room fell silent.
 b. Sarah and her family had gathered together in the living room to celebrate her brother's birthday.
 c. Full of anticipation, they waited in the darkness until the lights came back on.
